'''Thikkiiana City''' was a [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr tree]] [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It was a major exporter of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] technology, and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] used the computers for its [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|Defense Fleet]]. The city was [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Imperium Crisis)|raided]] by the [[Second Imperium]] to steal computer parts.<ref name="YJK" />
